text: The Argonaut Editor Application Please fill out the form below. Additionally, attach a resume, three to five samples of relevant work (stories, photos, videos, etc.) and a cover letter detailing your qualifications for the position(s) you are applying for. Turn in a physical copy of your application no later than 5 p.m. April 18.
